scope: G09 CUDA cancellation/claim linearization; finite source-only review
review_timing: After the implementation fix, before fixed-candidate runtime requalification; no build or runtime executed by this review.

previous_finding.reachable_window: The coordinator previously read cancel_requested=false at the loop top; cancel_completion could then store true under pipeline_mutex and return; the coordinator could subsequently frontier.take(kNative) outside that mutex and submit a previously unclaimed native job.
previous_finding.contract: Cancellation and new claims share one admission linearization point. A job claimed before cancellation wins the lock may finish and retire after cancellation; this is not device preemption.

checks.fact: cancel_completion, close, and both CPU/native claim paths share pipeline_mutex. The admission block re-reads cancel_requested before frontier.take and CPU command publication.
CPU command selection/publication and native selection are inside the same short critical section. If cancellation wins the lock, neither new claim is made.
Notification and submit_segment occur after releasing pipeline_mutex. The fix holds no admission mutex across CPU math, native submission, or waiting.

Stop/join/collect ordering remains: request child stop, wait for cpu_stopped, collect the already-entered CPU outcome, then let the original accepted-prefix aggregation retire real work. This narrow fix does not replace accepted work with a synthetic completion.

runtime.parent_reported_prior_fact: The first CUDA implementation run passed 81 common tests, original contracts/G08 joint, two 65-step slot journeys, and actual CUPTI device overlap. These are parent-reported earlier runtime results, not independently inspected or requalified here.
runtime.fixed_candidate_followup: Incremental regression plus one-worker, cancellation, and drop cases are to be executed and judged by the parent; source review does not pre-sign them.

limits: Only the specified cancellation/claim window was reviewed; no new capability scan.
No product, benchmark, registry, documentation, or public tool was changed.
Already-claimed jobs may still submit or complete after cancellation and must follow original retirement; this review does not promise leaf-level cancellation or preemption.
